Author: Krishan Pahal

High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 83
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 1930 of 2023
Applicant :- Sunil Kumar Ahuja

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Shadab Alam
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Krishan Pahal,J.
Heard Sri Shadab Alam, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Vibhav Anand Singh, learned AGA for the State and also perused the material available on records.

This is the second application moved by the applicant seeking anticipatory bail in connection with Case Crime No.129 of 2021, under Sections 420, 406 & 506 IPC, Police Station- Noida Sector-39,
District- Gautam Budh Nagar.

entities.text:
Police Station- Noida Sector-39,
District- Gautam Budh Nagar
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: His first anticipatory bail application was dismissed as withdrawn by this Court vide order dated 13.10.2022 passed in Criminal Misc. Anticipatory Bail Application u/s 438 Cr.P.C. No.9063 of 2022.

At the very outset, learned counsel for the applicant has claimed parity with the co-accused Vaibhav Ahuja who has already been granted anticipatory bail by another Bench of this Court in Criminal Misc. Anticipatory Bail Application u/s 438 Cr.P.C. No.11591 of 2021 vide order dated 11.01.2023.

Since the case of the applicant is at par with the co-accused who has already been granted Sunil Kumar Ahuja vs State Of U.P. on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/60617745/
1 anticipatory bail till the submission of police report, the applicant is also entitled for the same on the ground of parity.

entities.text: Sunil Kumar Ahuja vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel has further stated that the charge-sheet has not been filed in the matter and also the applicant has no criminal history.
The prayer for anticipatory bail has been vehemently opposed by learned AGA.
However, the aforesaid factual aspects of the parity to the co-accused and of no criminal history assigned to applicant, have not been disputed by him.
Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case, this Court is of the opinion that the applicant deserves to be granted anticipatory bail in connection with the aforesaid case.
